title: Ironforge Airfields
wikitext:
[[File:Ironforge Airfields.jpg|thumb|300px|Ironforge Airfields]]
The '''Ironforge Airfields''' is an airfield located in a high mountain valley northwest of the [[dwarf|dwarven]] capital of [[Ironforge]]. It has two landing strips, and several gnome pilots are there standing next to their planes or tinkering with them. Around the airfield, there are a series of dwarven buildings and structures. Mountaineers from Ironforge patrol the area, and some members of the [[Stormpike Guard]] can be found here too. Further north, near the [[Wetlands]], there is a crashed gnome plane along with some bones.
